spinner: A sundial: a paper dial with a blue gnomon hand from centre to rim, swept round by the light with its soft shade trailing and fading behind it, rim to rim.
skeleton: A paragraph not yet written: soft ink lines, all flush left, whose ends fade out like the seam, breathing slowly one after another so a pulse runs down the paragraph.
switch: A slot pressed into the paper with a paper disc that casts its own small shade; on, the slot becomes the blue plate.
check: Shallow wells pressed into the paper; ticked, the well turns into the blue plate and a paper tick is pencilled in, and the chosen radio holds a blue pebble with its own shade.
toast: It lands flat on the paper and then lifts off it, rising 2px while its shade grows in underneath.
dialog: A page lifted into the light on the deepest shade, over a backdrop that darkens towards the edges like the corners of a reading room.
tooltip: A slip of paper in the margin with a soft shade under it and an italic serif note, surfacing slowly.
steps: A table of contents: serif numerals joined by rules that fade at both ends, with the current step as the blue plate.
empty: No box, just the divider's soft patch of shade with the title set in italic serif inside it and a fading rule below.
link: A light underline at rest; under the pointer the word lies in a patch of the blue's own shade and the underline comes to full ink.
